script: Box jellyfish have 24 eyes. They are arranged in four clusters, one on each side of the box-shaped bell. Some of those eyes even have lenses, a bit like ours. Unlike most jellyfish, box jellyfish swim actively and can steer around obstacles. The sting of some species can kill a person within minutes. They have no brain, yet they still use their eyes to find their way. Follow Pixel Abyss for more strange facts from the deep.
